lives_lived.description: Has been having a rough day. Then again, a rough day is par for the course for you.

looped.description: Trapped in some form of time loop. When will it end? Who knows? Nobody.

wont_forget_eggs.description: Won't forget the eggs. Whatever that means.

entered_doppelganger.description: Seems to have some capacity to inhabit Doppelgangers.

was_nude.description: Enjoys a little time in the buff.

lives_lived.description: He's taken residence in your head with zero intention of leaving.

good_joke.description: Is fond of a good joke, even if at his own expense.

was_dreaming.description: Has the uncanny ability to identify when you're in a dream state.

baby_twice.description: Seems to be a monster baby, maybe.

doppelganger.name: Doppelganger
doppelganger.description: A monsterous creature intent on ending you.

lives_lived.description: Is tied somehow to your time loop nightmare.

doppelganger_once.description: Can be inhabited if the situation allows it.

baby_once.description: Has been known to masquerade as a French child of questionable origin.

lives_lived.description: Appreciates contestants showing up with proper equipment.

was_nude.description: He's seen some things. Most of them being you in the buff.

lives_lived.description: Won't stand up and is just imitating.
Dispenses wisdom with a smug competence.

system_reboots.description: Likes reboots, and he cannot lie.

lives_lived.description: Lover? I hardly even know her. Boom.

fought_dream_monster.description: Sustains itself on ill-conceived combat encounters.

little_you.name: Little You
little_you.description: Left behind when you inhabit the face in the sky.

lives_lived.description: Could help set you up for success.

1010_START.comment: You jolt awake. There's a lot going on. A fair is in town.
1010_START.speaker: player
dialog: [[EMOTE]][You stir at the sound of thunder.]
Was I hitting the cider again?
Did you ever consider that you might just be a layabout?
Emote: [The sound of dampened revellers floats in from the street.]
Crazy folk, heading to the fair in this weather.
Some of us have work to do.
I'm sure the critters could use some tending.

1012_START.speaker: player
dialog: [[EMOTE]][You stir at the sound of thunder.]
Huh, storms two days in a row.
Emote: [The sound of dampened revellers floats in from the street.]
Are those fair folk still going at it?
I've got to lay off the cider.

1013_START.speaker: player
dialog: [[EMOTE]][You stir at the sound of thunder.]
Wait, how many times have I made that joke?
Whatever, let's get this over with.

1020__FAKE_WORLD.comment: During your walk, you see a hazy form floating in the sky.
1020__FAKE_WORLD.speaker: player
dialog: I can't deal with this right now.
You're going to get a soggy head.
I'm glad the weather cleared up.
It's a shame I didn't bring any snacks.
Might need to draw straws to see who we eat.
I don't mean to alarm anyone, but...
Do those birds look a little off to you?
Like, do those birds even look like birds?

1030_TOURNEY.comment: Today's the fair. You remember the archery tourney. You remember you're a participant.
1030_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: Hold on to your knickers, bud.

1032_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: Ah yes, good ol' Mister Stabs.
Bane of fingers and toes everywhere.

1033_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: Glad I restrung it last night.

1034_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: Oh yeah, I've had this nightmare before.
Not forgetting my clothes this time.
Do you make a habit of showing up places in the buff?

1035_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: Ah yes, good ol' Mister Stabs.
[[EMOTE]][While fumbling for your sword, you fall over your bow and black out.]

1036_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: [[EMOTE]][While stowing your bow, you trip and fall on your sword. The world fades to black.]

1040_INVESTIGATE.comment: It's a normal morning. You hear a child crying. You don't have children.
1040_INVESTIGATE.speaker: player
dialog: Let's get this fire started again.
Maybe get some bacon frying too?
It's a baby wailing in French.
Can we do something about this?

1050_CHICKEN.speaker: player
dialog: Eh, might as well get started on the chores.
Pa and Ma will be expecting breakfast.
Life on the farm, am I right?

1051_CHICKEN.speaker: player
dialog: There's no work to be done.
They don't have to worry about villagers mysteriously disappearing.

1052_CHICKEN.speaker: player
dialog: To walk around without the shackles of humanity.
Why are you taking your clothes off?
You should definitely get those back on.
To strut through the pen, giving zero clucks.
I see what you did there.
And just channel your inner chicken.

1053_CHICKEN.speaker: player
dialog: And at the peak of your journey...

1054_CHICKEN.speaker: player
dialog: [[EMOTE]][Tears stream down your eyes as the world around you begins to make sense for the first time.]
See you in the next life, I guess.
[[EMOTE]][That night, wolves get into the chicken coop. The world goes black.]

1055_CHICKEN.speaker: player
dialog: These goats look a little... worn.
That's because these are a rare breed of...
Please get me out of here.
To the pigs it is, then!

1056_CHICKEN.speaker: player
dialog: So what do pigs even eat?
It's a total pain to get to.
Do you see what I see?
[[EMOTE]][The wolves don't seem keen to have been interrupted.]
Wow, you're good at this whole danger thing!
[[EMOTE]][The nearest wolf pounces before you can finish your quip. The world goes black.]

1060_INVESTIGATE.comment: The thing you're investigating turns out to be a doppelganger.
1060_INVESTIGATE.speaker: player
dialog: The cries were coming from over here, right?
Kind of weird the thing quieted down the moment we stepped outside.
Are you seeing what I'm seeing?
[[EMOTE]][The child changes form, its features becoming elongated and monsterous.]
[[EMOTE]][The creature lets loose a shriek and pounces. The world goes to black.]

1070_TOURNEY.comment: You attend the archery tourney but forgot your clothes
1070_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: [[EMOTE]][You march proudly to the tournament grounds.]
Why are they calling me Little Jon?
The world's a crazy place, man.
Looks like someones headed to the tourney well armed.
I've never met this fellow in my life.

1071_TOURNEY.comment: You attend the archery tourney but brought a sword
1071_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: Well, I'd love to help you.
You're here for an archery tourney.
Are you familiar with the sport of archery?
[[EMOTE]][The bureaucrat before you lets out a hearty chuckle.]
You've quite literally brought a knife to a bowfight.

1072_TOURNEY.comment: You attend the archery tourney with all required equipment. Pick your competition.
1072_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: We offer two types of entry.
The frst tourney involves distance shooting.
Immediately following that, we have the roving tourney.
Targets are closer but are rigged to move.
Which tourney are you wanting to enter?

1073_TOURNEY.comment: An archery accident gone bad kills you. (butts)
1073_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: [[EMOTE]][You make your way down to the tournament field.]
Ready to relive last year's embarassment?
We'll let the butts do the talking.
[[EMOTE]][With that quip, you end the conversation and turn away.]
[[EMOTE]][The sounds of steel being loosed rings in your ear.]
I think we might have made him mad.

1074_TOURNEY.comment: An archery accident gone bad kills you. (roving)
1074_TOURNEY.speaker: player
dialog: [[EMOTE]][You make your way down to the tournamnet field.]
Today's brave contestants are participating in the Most Dangerous Game!
Today's contestants are also today's targets.
This is not what we signed up for...
I think I'm in the wrong pl--
[[EMOTE]][The twang of an arrow loosing rings in your ear.]

1075_TOURNEY.comment: Leads to 1071 (registration) but with additional flavor.
1075_TOURNEY.speaker: player
